title: Orbit Propagator Numerical (high precision)
text: Propagate orbit of one or more spacecraft using Kepler universal variable formulation, 15 inputs, 4 outputs, {Ephemeris model} sets Ephemeris model; {Propagation method} sets the orbit propagation method Kepler, {Input external accelerations} sets the input additional accelerations, {External acceleration coordinate frame} sets the frame for additional, {State vector output coordinate frame} sets the port coordinate frame, {Start date/time (UTC Julian date)} sets the initial start time for simulation, {Output current date/time (UTC Julian date)} adds output port t utc, {Mass source}, {Mass} sets the spacecraft mass used by atmospheric drag, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior, {Initial state format} sets the input method for initial states of orbit Orbital, {Orbit Type} sets the orbit classification, {Semi-major axis} sets the half of major axis of ellipse, {Eccentricity} sets the deviation of orbit, {Inclination (deg)} sets the tilt angle of orbital plane, {RAAN (deg)} sets the angular distance in equatorial plane, {Argument of periapsis (deg)} sets the angle from spacecraft ascending node, {True anomaly} sets the angle between periapsis and initial position, {Argument of latitude (deg)} sets the angle between ascending node and initial position, {Longitude of periapsis (deg)} sets the angle between ICRF x -axis and eccentricity, {True longitude (deg)} sets the angle between ICRF x -axis and initial position, {ICRF position} sets the cartesian position vector of spacecraft, {ICRF velocity} sets the cartesian velocity vector, {Fixed-frame position} sets the position vector, {Fixed-frame velocity} sets the velocity vector, {Central body} sets the celestial body around which spacecraft orbits, {Gravitational potential model} controls gravity model for central body Spherical harmonics when Central body set to Earth, Moon, Mars, or Custom, Oblate ellipsoid when Central body set to Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, {Spherical harmonic model}, {Spherical harmonic coefficient file} sets the harmonic coefficient MAT file, {Degree}, {Use Earth orientation parameters (EOPs)}, {IERS EOP data file} sets the earth orientation data, {Input Moon libration angles} sets the moon libration angle rate, {Output quaternion (ICRF to Fixed-frame)} adds output transformation quaternion port, {Central body spin axis source} sets the central body spin, {Spin axis right ascension (RA) at J2000 (deg)} sets the right ascension of central body spin axis, {Spin axis RA rate (deg/century)} sets the right ascension rate of central body spin, {Spin axis declination (Dec) at J2000 (deg)} sets the declination of central body spin axis, {Spin axis Dec rate (deg/century)} sets the declination rate of central body spin axis, {Initial rotation angle at J2000 (deg)} sets the rotation angle of central body x -axis, {Rotation rate (deg/day)} sets the rotation rate of central body x -axis, {Equatorial radius}, {Flattening}, {Gravitational parameter}, {Second degree zonal harmonic (J2)} sets the most significant or largest spherical harmonic term, {Include atmospheric drag} sets the option to include atmospheric drag, {Atmospheric density source} sets the source of atmospheric density, {Atmospheric model}, {Flux source} sets the source of space weather, {Space weather data file} sets the mAT file of space weather data, {F10.7 extrapolation method} sets the extrapolation method for f107Average and f107Daily None, {F10.7 extrapolation value} sets the extrapolation value to assign to f107Average and to calculate, {Magnetic index extrapolation method} sets the extrapolation method for magnetic index information None, {Magnetic index extrapolation value} sets the extrapolation value used to calculate magnetic index, {Flags source} sets the variation flag source, {Flags} sets the variation flags ones, {Include anomalous oxygen in density calculation} sets the option to include anomalous oxygen in density, {Drag coefficient source} sets the source of drag, {Drag coefficient} sets the spacecraft coefficient of drag, {Drag area source} sets the source of drag, {Drag area} sets the area to compute acceleration due to atmospheric, {Limit ephemerides date range} sets the option to enable start and end of range of ephemeris, {Start date (JD)} sets the start date of ephemerides date range, {End date (JD)} sets the end date of ephemerides date range, {Include third body gravity} sets the acceleration due to third body gravity, {Sun} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Sun gravity model} sets the third body gravity model for Sun, {Mercury} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Mercury gravity model}, {Venus} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Venus gravity model}, {Earth} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Earth gravity model}, {Moon} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Moon gravity model}, {Mars} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Mars gravity model}, {Jupiter} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Jupiter gravity model}, {Saturn} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Saturn gravity model}, {Uranus} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Uranus gravity model}, {Neptune} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Neptune gravity model}, {Pluto} sets the include gravitational acceleration due, {Pluto gravity model}, {Custom} sets the include gravitational acceleration due to custom, {Custom gravity model}, {Gravitational parameter (m^3/s^2)} sets the custom gravitational acceleration, {Include solar radiation pressure (SRP)} sets the acceleration due to solar radiation, {Eclipse fraction source} sets the source of eclipse, {Shadow model}, {Include Earth} sets the option to include Earth, {Include Moon} sets the option to include Moon, {Reflectivity coefficient source} sets the source for spacecraft coefficient, {Reflectivity coefficient} sets the spacecraft coefficient of reflectivity, {SRP area source} sets the source for spacecraft solar radiation pressure area, {SRP area} sets the cross section area of the spacecraft seen, {Solar flux pressure (W*s/m^3)} sets the spacecraft solar flux pressure, {Units} sets the parameter and port units Metric, {Angle units} and {Time format}. Values come from the instance.
